meta.schema_change: schema 2 (2026-10-31): max_stroke_mm (Chrono true rod stroke vs harness reading, mixed) split into max_stroke_reading_mm and max_stroke_true_mm; d_max_stroke_mm replaced by d_max_stroke_reading_mm (d_max_stroke_true_mm when both sides have it); summary adds d_max_stroke_reading_mm_chrono_minus_harness; meta adds missing_stroke_records. Readers of d_max_stroke_mm should use d_max_stroke_reading_mm. schema 3 (2026-10-31, spec 432.4.5): final_pairs / final_summary (final controller Chrono vs final harness, see final_pairs_note); per pair censored_at_guard, censored_side and Chrono stroke_guard_events (harness records carry stroke_guard_events); summaries add the uncensored reading-delta stats and the censored list; curated S9SL C-1..C-4 and X4-rp now carry the Chrono stroke reading. h6_margin quotes spec 432.4.5 (stroke +23 mm, reading vs reading) and is not re-derived here. schema 3 addition (2026-10-31, final 10 runs): the automatic P3b verdict counts a P3-2 judged flag (late_loc_revoked / late_loc_reapproach, spec 419.8 / 424.8.1) as pass and lists it in chrono flags (key present only with a FLAG); final pairs may carry superseded_by (left out of final_summary, listed in final_summary.superseded).
meta.stroke_quantities: max_stroke_reading_mm = controller stroke reading (Chrono: max of record meas.stroke per leg FL, FR, RL, RR; harness: max(plant.sref)); max_stroke_true_mm = true rod stroke (Chrono: P3-5 s_motor_max_m per leg or the spec value; harness: not stored). The reading exceeds the true stroke by F_cyl/k_oil (about 5-6 mm at 68 kN). Deltas pair the same quantity only; a per-leg list counts by its max.
meta.censoring: censored_at_guard = true when either run fired the lift-stroke guard (WARN_LIFT_STROKE_LIMITED / FAULT_LIFT_STROKE_LIMIT; Chrono: result.json events, harness: record warnings); false when both sides are known and none fired; null when a side is unknown and the other did not fire. The max stroke reading of a guarded run is bounded by the guard (682.8 mm budget), so d_max_stroke_reading_mm is a bound there: Chrono side only -> lower bound of Chrono - harness, harness side only -> upper bound, both -> no information.
meta.classification: optimistic if harness verdict better, or Chrono READY - harness > 5 s, or harness min F / Chrono > 1.10, or Chrono gap - harness < -10 mm; conservative = the opposite (READY < -5 s, ratio < 0.90, verdict worse); mixed = both (ASSUMPTION thresholds)
meta.version_caveat: Harness = R2DS (05708b2 line). Chrono = the stored run version (column). Pairs whose versions differ are trend evidence, not identity; re-run on the final acceptance files. final_pairs: Chrono final controller = final harness (finB2 / fin_x426_D).
meta.final_pairs_note: final_pairs = the final-controller Chrono runs (FINAL_RUNS: FINAL-REP 7 + FINAL6 1 + RV6 X6-rb2 1 + FINAL-REP-X 1; the 120 s x1.1 J2 run is superseded by FINAL-REP-X) with their final-harness twins (final_harness_files), same version on both sides. They are summarized apart in final_summary and are NOT counted in summary: summary keeps the 54 stored-version pairs (several are the same cases at older versions; counting both would count a case twice). combined_counts adds the two verdict-match counts for reference only. Chrono verdict = the automatic P3b block (all P3B_PASS_CHECKS) unless the run carries the control verdict of its spec section (then verdict_auto keeps the automatic one). Pairs with censored_at_guard true give a bound, not a value: they are left out of the *_uncensored stroke stats and listed in censored_stroke_reading. Pairs with superseded_by are replaced by that run: kept in final_pairs, left out of final_summary counts and listed in final_summary.superseded. Pending runs (final_pending_runs) are not paired yet.
meta.h6_margin: H-6 optimistic margin (ASSUMPTION, spec 432.4 / 432.4.5 / 432.4.7, 2026-10-31): flat READY +17 s, gap -13 mm (RV2 J2 -12.7 mm, 432.4.4); soft slope rows gap -15 mm (X6-rb2 -14.5 mm, 432.4.7); stroke reading one-sided +23 mm (Chrono meas.stroke max - harness max(plant.sref); observed X6-rb vs H9 roll_neg@k0.65 >= +22.7 mm censored at the guard, RV3 C-C1 +21.5 mm uncensored; stroke sensor share <= 0.4 mm) for soft J1/J2/S1 incl. one-pad patches, not G1 or rigid; slope / x1.1 READY +31 s
